{{Quote|You've racked up quite a debt to some Trandoshan pirates. Does your crew know you've been gambling?|[[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Minister of Intelligence]], to Kavork|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Kavork''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] from the [[Red Meteor Consortium]] during the time of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> he was based on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. He owed a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] debt to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] pirate [[Boruush]]. Following the [[Battle of Ilum]], Kavork and the Red Meteor Consortium pirates raided a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] transport and captured the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite-frozen]] [[Shara Jenn]]. During the [[Revanite crisis]], the former [[Cipher Nine]] and former [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Intelligence Minister]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sought to retrieve Shara Jenn from Kavork's pirates. This prompted Cipher Nine to kill Boruush during the Minister's meeting with Kavork so as to convince the latter of the Minister's influence and how far it extended. This in turn meant he no longer owed a debt to the deceased Trandoshan. Kavork thus accepted to release Shara Jenn.<ref name="TOR" />
